capture.method: The kernel renders this document from its own deck composition (kit/entity/present resolves the policy, ui/screens serves the document); the copy is the file at the named commit, byte for byte. It is the only capture in this repository whose resolved block states a stepped form, which is why the stepped reading is proved against kernel bytes and not against a document written here.
capture.result: One entry, note/note, whose resolved layout states an update form of one step: key unsectioned, labelled Details, asking title, body, rank, pinned and tags in that order with the literal verb Save the note. Its create form and its typed-read form are absent, which is how the kernel prints a form a person is not walked through.
capture.scope: A stepped edit form and the flat create form beside it, in one entry. It carries no multi-step form and no sectioned step, which is why the fake in tests/fakes/steps.ts states the kernel's own three-step create case.
